name: descrybe-legal-engine
description: Research U.S. case law, statutes, regulations, and court rules. Find authorities, check quotations against opinions, and see how later courts cite a case.
suggestedPrompts: Use Descrybe to look up 347 U.S. 483. Give me the case name, court, and year, with a link to the opinion.
Use Descrybe to check whether Brown v. Board of Education, 347 U.S. 483, contains the sentence “Separate educational facilities are inherently unequal.” Show the matching passage.
Use Descrybe to find the California statute on returning a residential security deposit. Cite the section and link to the source.
